official_name_basis: ChatGPTプラグイン詳細画面の表示名
original_description:
Turn a family trip into a photo book, write a bedtime story about a favorite animal, or design a thank-you card for a neighbor.

Create and refine books, cards, invitations, posters, clothing graphics, textile patterns, personalized gift artwork and business materials in your ChatGPT conversation. Available image and export tools depend on your session.

Explicitly save the drafts and original files you choose. Preview saved work, download your files and continue your project in another conversation. Nothing is automatically saved or sent to production.
description_scope: 詳細ページの説明本文
summary_ja: 本・カード・漫画などの制作物を作り、選んだ下書きを保存する。
limitations_ja: 画像・書き出しツールはセッションによって異なる。自動保存や製造への送信は行わないと説明。
